import datetime

W = {
    " ": 278, "!": 278, '"': 355, "#": 556, "$": 556, "%": 889, "&": 667,
    "'": 191, "(": 333, ")": 333, "*": 389, "+": 584, ",": 278, "-": 333,
    ".": 278, "/": 278, "0": 556, "1": 556, "2": 556, "3": 556, "4": 556,
    "5": 556, "6": 556, "7": 556, "8": 556, "9": 556, ":": 278, ";": 278,
    "<": 584, "=": 584, ">": 584, "?": 556, "@": 1015, "A": 667, "B": 667,
    "C": 722, "D": 722, "E": 667, "F": 667, "G": 722, "H": 722, "I": 278,
    "J": 500, "K": 667, "L": 556, "M": 833, "N": 722, "O": 778, "P": 667,
    "Q": 778, "R": 722, "S": 667, "T": 611, "U": 722, "V": 667, "W": 944,
    "X": 667, "Y": 667, "Z": 611, "[": 278, "\\": 278, "]": 278, "^": 469,
    "_": 556, "`": 333, "a": 556, "b": 556, "c": 500, "d": 556, "e": 556,
    "f": 278, "g": 556, "h": 556, "i": 278, "j": 222, "k": 500, "l": 278,
    "m": 833, "n": 556, "o": 556, "p": 556, "q": 556, "r": 333, "s": 500,
    "t": 278, "u": 556, "v": 500, "w": 722, "x": 500, "y": 500, "z": 500,
    "{": 334, "|": 260, "}": 334, "~": 584,
}
DEFAULT_W = 556


def text_width(s, size, bold=False):
    total = sum(W.get(ch, DEFAULT_W) for ch in s)
    w = total * size / 1000.0
    return w * 1.06 if bold else w


def esc(s):
    return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def build_pdf(pages):
    """pages: list of dicts {width, height, items: [(text, font, size, x, y)]}"""
    n_pages = len(pages)
    kids = " ".join(f"{3 + i} 0 R" for i in range(n_pages))
    # Assemble objects in final order: catalog, pages, then per-page
    # (page, font, content)
    objs = [b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>"]
    objs.append(f"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [{kids}] /Count {n_pages} >>".encode())
    for page in pages:
        bold = any(it[1] == "Helvetica-Bold" for it in page["items"])
        font_name = "Helvetica-Bold" if bold else "Helvetica"
        lines = []
        for text, font, size, x, y in page["items"]:
            lines.append(
                f"BT /F1 {size} Tf {x:.2f} {y:.2f} Td ({esc(text)}) Tj ET"
            )
        stream = "\n".join(lines).encode()
        page_num = len(objs) + 1
        font_num = page_num + 1
        content_num = page_num + 2
        objs.append(
            (
                f"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 {page['width']} {page['height']}] "
                f"/Resources << /Font << /F1 {font_num} 0 R >> >> "
                f"/Contents {content_num} 0 R >>"
            ).encode()
        )
        objs.append(
            f"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /{font_name} >>".encode()
        )
        objs.append(
            b"<< /Length " + str(len(stream)).encode() + b" >>\nstream\n"
            + stream + b"\nendstream"
        )

    pdf = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n%\xe2\xe3\xcf\xd3\n")
    offsets = []
    for i, obj in enumerate(objs, start=1):
        offsets.append(len(pdf))
        pdf.extend(f"{i} 0 obj\n".encode())
        pdf.extend(obj)
        pdf.extend(b"\nendobj\n")
    xref_pos = len(pdf)
    pdf.extend(f"xref\n0 {len(objs) + 1}\n".encode())
    pdf.extend(b"0000000000 65535 f \n")
    for off in offsets:
        pdf.extend(f"{off:010d} 00000 n \n".encode())
    pdf.extend(
        f"trailer\n<< /Size {len(objs) + 1} /Root 1 0 R >>\nstartxref\n{xref_pos}\n%%EOF\n".encode()
    )
    return bytes(pdf)
